request.spec:
A grade merge is now retroactive: for every person it moves, every grade record of theirs on the
merged grade becomes the other grade, so all their claims, whatever their date, use the other
grade's rates (and its terms and thresholds) from then on. Frozen figures and figures bound by a
statement are unchanged.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A grade merge is now retroactive: for every person it moves, every grade record of theirs on the
merged grade becomes the other grade, so all their claims, whatever their date, use the other
grade's rates (and its terms and thresholds) from then on. Frozen figures and figures bound by a
statement are unchanged.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A grade merge now changes a moved person's grade for all dates, not just from today. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests.

**The change, in two files:**
- `People.java` has a new method, `regrade(id, grade, into)`. It changes every one of the person's grade records on the merged grade to the other grade, whatever the record's from-date.
- `MergeGrade.java` calls it for each moved person, right after their usual save. So all their claims, at any date, now use the other grade's rates, terms and thresholds.

**Audit file:** each moved person still gets their `PERSON_EDITED` line and rollup lines first. The whole merge's rollup lines come after, and they now show the retroactive figures. That is the order the test expects.

**What's left alone:** the merge doesn't change frozen figures or figures bound by a statement, and it adds no new grade records. The person form's own from-date grade changes work as before.

No database schema change or front-end change was needed.
